about: Whole Moon. Cell (i, j) is centred at lon = lon0_deg + i * step_deg (east positive), lat = lat0_deg + j * step_deg. Values are stored row by row from the south: index = j * n_lon + i. terrain says whether the skyline came from an elevation grid (true) or the Moon was treated as a smooth ball (false).

heights.about: Ground height in metres as 16-bit little-endian integers, row by row from the south, each row starting at 180 W.
